rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); GpuSurface (gpu_surface_dawn.cpp) no longer installs Dawn's process-global proc table itself. It calls the framework-neutral pulp::render::ensure_dawn_procs() seam, which runs Pulp's native default once per process unless an embedding host registered its own installer (install or verify-only) with set_dawn_proc_installer() beforehand; a late registration is refused. The only proc-table setter moves to gpu_proc_installer_native.cpp. No frame, present, readback, design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp render target has not adopted a Vellum package.
